adjudication.rationale: The finding claims that sendAddGuestsEmails forwards additionalNotes and fails a 'redaction contract' from sendScheduledEmails. However, looking at the diff: 1) The sendAddGuestsEmails function in email-manager.ts simply calls formatCalEvent and sends emails - there's no hideCalendarNotes parameter being passed or expected. 2) The CalendarEvent 'evt' constructed in addGuests.handler.ts does not include additionalNotes at all - it only has title, type, description, startTime, endTime, organizer, attendees, uid, recurringEvent, location, destinationCalendar, and seatsPerTimeSlot/seatsShowAttendees. 3) There is no 'hideCalendarNotes' parameter or redaction contract visible in this diff. The finding references behavior and contracts that don't exist in the code shown.
